request.description: The borrower role on a party: for an individual, the signed-in person; for an MSME, the business (created and linked to the person as proprietor, partner or director by `subSegment`). Returns the existing profile if there is one. Borrower context (the applicant's own records, reached through their login); partner context sees applications its firm filed (M3c). Lists and reads never show other people's records.
